text.p: Sealed proposals will be received by The State of Delaware (the
State'') at the offices of Sau
ick & Saul, PNC Bank Center, 12th Floor, 222 Delaware Avenue, Wilmington, Delaware 19801 until 10:00 a.m. Eastern Standard Time:
for the purchase of the above referenced bonds (the

Bonds'') of the State, all dated January 1, 1997, all bearing interest payable on July 1, 1997, and semiannually thereafter on January 1 and July 1 until maturity or earlier redemption. The Bonds will mature in various amounts from January 1, 1998 through January 1, 2017.

If no acceptable bid is received on such date, the State will receive sealed proposals for the Bonds on such later day or days as shall be determined by the State, at the offices of Saul, Ewing, Remick & Saul set forth above, until the Bonds are sold or this Notice is withdrawn by the State.
Notice of any day, other than Tuesday, January 7, 1997 for receiving sealed proposals for the Bonds will be
communicated by the State through Munifacts News Service.

Copies of the Notice of Sale and Proposal for Bonds, together with copies of the Preliminary Official Statement issued in connection with the sale of the Bonds may be obtained from the offices of the State's Financial Advisor, O'Brien Partners Inc., 505 Park Avenue-14th Floor, New York, New York 10022, (212) 935-7882.
